text: Bug proposal: essential fields such as server name, type, hostname, port, socket type, authentication, and username belong at the top level; optional settings may remain under prefs. Use portable strings instead of local numeric constants. Rebuild caches records to retain unknown data; engine versions rise to 2 and older server data is reset. Bug is fixed. Its later listed regressions are Bug 1909393 and Bug 1909424.
title: Bug 1888023 Sync record redesign
